issue.title: AttributeError: Unable to lookup 'transit_processor' on TransitAgency or TransitAgencyAdmin or TransitAgencyForm

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the transit_processor admin lookup error, but two existing tests (TestTransitAgencyAdmin.test_get_exclude[staff-expected0] and test_get_readonly_fields[staff-expected0]) passed before the fix and fail after it, and no test was found that guards the fix. Look next at what those two tests expect for staff users and whether the fix's change to the excluded and read-only field…
